tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sku gsung thugs snying po'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho ga bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// bla ma dang mgon po gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal mthu stobs rgya mtsho snying rje'i srub shing gis bsrubs tshe// mgon po'i thig ler legs par 'khrungs pa dam chos nyin mo la nyin dang*// srid gsum mnan pa'i dpung pa'i khengs ldan bdud mun la bdud kyi// mahā kā la'i snang ba'i nang na che las yang che la'o// rtsa ba'i rgyud las bstan pa'i zil// bshad pa'i lung gis dngar byas pa// grub pa'i ngag gis brgyan pa'i bcud// padma dkar po'i kha las 'thon// de phyir lnga brgya tha ma'i rdzing*// mgon po'i bstan pa'i nyid 'od lhung*// de myang rgyal bas lung bstan lo// de ni kho bo min pa su// de yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje snying po ye shes kyi dngos grub sgrub cing bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs chen po dpa' ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i srung ma las la bkol ba'i dus lnga brgya tha mar/ gnas bsam gtan gang bya ba dang rjes su mthun par/ gang zag bsgral bar bya ba/ snying rjes de sgrol par 'dod pa'i sgrub pa pos dpal 'khor lo sdom pa legs par bsnyen cing*/ lta ba gtan la phebs pas bden 'dzin gyi dbal bcom pa/ thams cad sgyu ma tsam du shes pa zhig gis/ thabs bla ma mnyes par dbang zhus/ dam tshig dang ldan pas rgyud byin gyis lobs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnas tshul bzhin du thob nas/ chos nyid kyi rtsal sgyu ma tsam tshangs pa'i gnas par langs te/ rim pa bzhin mngon du byed pa ni/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po dang*/ 'phrin las la sbyar ba gsum las/ dang po la/ bsnyen pa/ nye bar bsnyen pa gnyis kyi dang po/ lhag pa'i lhar sbyar bgegs gtor bskrad// mdun bskyed byin rlabs spyan 'dren mchod// bsre dbang rgyas btab phyag byin brlab// mchod bzhi gtor ma bstod bzlas slar// mchod bstod bsdu bsngo bkra shis so// rgyas 'dod bstod rjes tshogs las te// byin brlab spyan 'dren mchod bshags bskang*// gser skyems gzu dpang brub sogs bskyed// dgug bskul sdig bsgo dbye dang gsang*// brdung btab tshogs rol lhag ma bsngo// zhes pa'i cho gas rtags dus grangs rab 'bring tha mar byas te bsnyen par bya'o// nye bar bsnyen pa ni/

gzhan 'dra ba la/ bdag gi thugs ka las rgyu'i hūm̐ spro ba dang*/ zhal myur blta'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa chen po la// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rnam pa gnyis// dang pos cho ga sta gon te// dang po brtag bslang sbyang gzung ba// snga ma sa dang lto 'phye'o// bar bsnyen 'dra snang sbyang mi snang*// gsum pa bgegs sbyang sri mnan sbyang*// bzhi pa bdag bskyed gsol btab khro// bka' bsgo stang stabs bsrung mchod do// phyogs gsar pa yin na sa'i phyogs dang lto 'phye brtag par bya'o// yul de'i bdag po la gnang ba zhu zhing*/ dkyil 'khor bca' 'dod pa der phyin nas bsnyen dus bzhin/ bdag nyid lhar gsal bgegs la gtor ma byin/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas mchod nas/ dbang bskur rgyu'i slob ma rnams der bos nas 'og bzhin gsol ba btab/ bgegs sdig pa mi shes pa sbyang ba 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin byas bsnyen pa'i mtshan ma thob nas mdun du dri'i thig le me tog gi tshoms bu mtha' mchod pas bskor ba bshams nas/ mdun du laṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lte ba yan chad sa se ba nas 'thon par bsams la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi lha mo spyan drangs te/ hūm̐/ lha mo chen mo sa 'dzin 'jig rten yum// rin chen sna tshogs na bza'i rgyan gyis brgyan// do shal rkang gdub rgyan ldan sems ma khyod// mchod pa 'di bzhes 'di ru byin brlab mdzod// e hye he pri thi wi de wi ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas nam mkhar byon pa la sumbha ni sogs kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃhoḥ.oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas rin po ches dbu brgyan/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/

pā dyaṃ sogs rnam lnga rol mo/ oṃ a kā ro sa gtor ma phul/ khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste// sku phyed 'thon pa gser kyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// sa 'og gtso mo khyod la bstod// sa gnon gyi phyag rgya// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sbyong pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes dang*/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang*// gang yang sa la brten pa rnams// sems can rnams la dge don du// byams pa'i sems kyis gnang bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas// rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis sa'i phyogs 'di ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin par bsams la gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi badzra muḥ zhes brjod pas de nyid du thim par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma gnyis pa/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis bye brag gi sa'i bdag po 'khor bcas ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug la/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā re oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos nas/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyod kyis stsal du gsol// zhes brjod pas ci dga' bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin nas badzra muḥrang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ tshoms bu dang mchod rdzas bsdu/ de nas bdag nyid he ru ka rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad du gyur nas/ lag pa g.yas la gshin rje mthar byed/ g.yon la shes rab mthar byed/ kha la padma mthar byed/ gsang bar bgegs mthar byed/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo mgon po/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug pa sngon po/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug gtong 'khor los sgyur ba/

rkang pa gnyis la gnod mdzes rgyal po bsgom/ seng ldeng la sogs pa drag po'i shing gi phur bu chur sor bcu gnyis pa/ sboms su sor bzhi pa/ tsan dan dmar pos byugs pa kha dog sna lnga'i skud pa dkris te/ mgo bor me tog dang yungs kar bcings pa rnams bsangs nas/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ gṛ pa ya gṛ hṇā pa ya huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bi dya rā dza huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas de las sprul pa'i gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'ongs te/ des bgegs dang log 'dren rnams lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams dril bus mnyes te phyogs bcur gan kyal du bsgyel ba'i khar/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyis rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa kha sang bar bzhag nas rang nyid stod khro bo smad rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje phur bu'i rnam par snang ba bgegs rnams kyi mgo bor gnas pa la/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭaṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā pā na phaṭ phaṭ huṃ hūm̐/ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha ra ya dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bi gha naṃ kā ya wā ka tsittaṃ badzra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra mudga ra badzra kī la ya/ ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ zhes gnod mdzes kyi rdo rje lcags kyu de tho ba me rab tu 'bar bar gyur pas phur bu rnams sdigs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug ste gser gyi sa gzhi la bsgrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur/ de rnams las ye shes me kha dog lnga rab tu 'bar bas gdug pa can thams cad bsregs par gyur par bsam/ dngos su las kyi rdo rjes phur skor byed cing phyogs bcur phur pa gdab/ steng 'og tu 'debs ma thub na nub dang shar du/ de nas phur bu rnams srung 'khor bzhin du khro bcur bsgoms te mchod bstod bzlas pa bya'o// de bzhin du nyin zhag so sor phur bu rnams mchod par yang bya'o// de nas dam sri bsgral ba/

gdab las 'phrin las bzhin la/ sdig bsgo dang lha dbye bzhag tshab tu/ hūm̐/ dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod// dug gsum nyon mongs dbang du song*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po bshig /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku dgrar gyur// pho nya lcags kyus mi 'gugs su// ngan song gnas la 'khyam la dga'// rgyab rten dbang du mi bsdu ru// sdig pa'i grogs pos gtong ma phod// phyag rgya dra bas mi bcing du// khyod kyi lus sems sdod mi nyan// ling ga'i rten la mi bstim du// bag chags ngan par rten ma byung*// rnon po rtsang gis mi bskor du// dam sri 'phung sri 'gros la dga'// ye shes phur bas mi 'debs su// ngan song gnas su gzhol la dga'// shes rab ral gris mi gtub tu// gti mug mun par 'khyams par 'gyur/ thun rdzas rnams kyis mi brab tu// lus sems rdul du 'gro ma nyan// dug chu khol mas mi sbyang du// ye nas nyon mongs dug gis gzir// khro bo'i zhal du mi btab tu// gzugs phung sha khrag rul pa'i rgyu// de nas bka' la mi gdags su// phyin chad ngan spyod dgag par byed// mthar btab cing khyi thod la sogs pa sgor mnan nas las kyi gshin rje la gtad pa/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba rten bzhi'i rngams 'og nas// las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni// ya mtshan chen po rmad du byung*// mun nag 'thibs pa'i nang du bzhugs// g.yas pa'i lag na ri rab thogs// g.yon pa'i lag na rgya mtsho 'khrug /zhabs kyis rlung gi 'khor lo mnan// dam nyams las kyi dam sri la// mnan pa las kyi dus la bab// sgo med lcags khang nang du chug /gshin rje rnams kyi zas su byin// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon// rgya mtsho chen po'i gting la chug /ri rab chen po'i rmang du gnon// nam yang gtong bar ma byed cig /de nas mgon po'i bro brdung ba// hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// khrag 'thung chen po rigs lnga'i sku// ye shes mgon po'i rang bzhin te// mahā kā las nam mkha' gang*// 'jigs byed ma mo sprin ltar gtibs// lha srin sde brgyad sa gzhi khyab// bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med// tshangs pa'i dbyangs su byas nas su// glu ni bar chad med par len// bdud dpung thams cad gzhom pa'i phyir// bro ni bar chad med par brdung*// stong nyid gdangs su chems se chems// rdo rje bro rdung khrigs se khrigs//

phyogs sar par sa'i ro lnga bsal// gter bcug las dang mthun pa'i sas bkang pa la'am/ gzhan du ba byung gi rnam lnga kho nas byug oṃ bhūṃ khaṃ zhes brjod de sa gzhi nam mkhar bsam/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ zhes rdo rje'i sa gzhir bskyed/ oṃ maṃ di nī badzra bha wa badzra bandha hūm̐/ zhes pas sa gzhi rnam par dag pa de bzhin nyid du mos pas byin gyis brlabs la gnas gang yol ba bla res brgyan/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus gang 'ong sar slob dpon phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te 'dug la/ 'chad 'gyur bzhin gyi bdag bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi bar du bsgom/ de nas nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas la mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod kyis mchod nas thal mo sbyar bdug spos 'thul lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer bskyed de/ yang dag ye shes sems dpa' che// 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal byed pa// rgyal ba ma lus bstan skyong gtso// bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin// shar nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spongs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chas las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// byang nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bsdus nas shar phyogs su mnyam pa'i rkang stabs kyi thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag byas te sems bskyed nas/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun par lhung zhing bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa rnams la bltas nas/

de rnams kyi bdud gzhom pa'i bsam pas skad cig gis rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad mgon po phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma dang*/ g.yon par ṭa las zla ba dang*/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar bsam ste rdo rje'i lta stangs kyis phyogs thams cad du bltas la/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma ting lo chang bus bskor zhing phyir dor/ hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /gal te bka' las 'das pa na// rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de yi nyen la ma bsdo bar// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di long las// myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /sa'i phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ skyong ba dang*/ bsrung ba'i phyir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po rtsom gyis/ gang su yang rung bas phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang*/ rgan mo g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig 'di ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ sumbha ni brjod/ de'i dus su rdo rje gsor ba dang dril bu dkrol bar bya zhing khro bo du ma spros pas bgegs bcom ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi hūm̐ las rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ bskor ba g.yas bskor du lan gsum bya/

rgyas par 'dod na/ gzhi bca' rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ dbus su g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang dang mnyam pa'i stabs dang*/ de bzhin du gzhi bca' ral gri'i phyag rgyas reg cing shar du zlum po'i stabs dang*/ gzhi bca' rin po che'i phyag rgyas reg nas lhor rol pa'i stabs dang*/ gzhi bca' 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas reg nas nub tu rdo rje'i gdan nam sa ga'i stabs dang*/ gzhi bca' padma'i phyag rgyas reg nas byang du dāṇḍa pa'i stabs te gar stabs kyis bcag cing bskor bar bya'o// de nas

oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i chus bdag gnas slob ma rnams la nye reg byas te bsrung*/ phyogs der dri la sogs pas mchod do// sta gon bzhi ste sa dang lha// bum pa slob ma lhag gnas so// dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la kha bltas te bdag lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ sa'i lha mo bskyed pa nas bstim pa'i bar sa chog bzhin/ de nas lha'i gnas ma 'chol bar/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi/ gzhan rnams la zlum po// de rnams su lha so so'i sngags brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ de nas dam tshig pa bskyed pa la/ de'i khar rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba re zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam las btab pa'i bar bsnyen pa ji lta ba de nas pus mo btsugs te spos dang rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes snyan gsan dbab bo// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te mdzub mo bsgrad pa'i rtse sprad la kha 'og tu phyogs pas spyi bor bzhag hūm̐ badzra uttiṣṭha zhes bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg go/ tshoms bu bsdu/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgu gu gul gyis bdug bgegs bskrad/ mgul chings dang mtshan ma bkod/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gi kha brgyan/ bum rdzas dang srog chags med pa'i chus sum gnyis dgang*/ rgyal ba bkra shis shar dang mer/ grub pa srung ba lho dang bden bral/ rgyal ba zhi ba nub dang rlung*/ dngos grub rdzu 'phrul byang dang dbang ldan/ rnam rgyal dbus/ las thams cad pa g.yon te stegs gtsang ma'i khar bzhag rnam par rgyal ba'i khar rnam rgyal chen po thod pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang ba/

steng du me tog gi 'phreng ba btags pa'i rdo rje bzhag de nas oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba rnam rgyal chen po nang stong gsum tsam du yangs par/ baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dbus su paṃ las padma'i sdong po la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba re zhes pa nas bzlas pa'i rab bsnyen pa'i bsdus pa ji lta ba bzhin/ rtsibs gling grwa khyams sogs mi 'don pa tsam mo// lha bskyed dus rnam rgyal du mkha' 'gro drug yan/ lhag ma rnams phyogs so sor mtshan ma yang dam tshig par bskyed/ rnam rgyal chen por dkyil 'khor gyi lha yongs rdzogs dgu med na rnam rgyal du lha thams cad dang*/ las thams cad par las mgon lcam dral bskyed do// me tog gi 'phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje gzung bas bum pa la reg la/ gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ gzhan rnams kyi snying po nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te me tog dor bas/ lha rnams chags pa chen pos zhu bas byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo// bum pa mchod/ ji ltar dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs par de srid du bgegs rnams bsrung par gyis shig brjod/ de dag la reg bstod do// slob ma lhag gnas khrus maṇḍal// snyan gsol spro sdom rab gnas bya// so shing khyor chu bsrung skud gdags// ku sha gtad cing chos 'chad pa'o// slob ma rnams khrus byas maṇḍal phul/ thal mo sbyor gral 'khod pa la// gsang sngags don grub don gnyer gang*// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// 'jig rten pha rol la gzhol ba// kha cig dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug byed// 'jig rten gzhan don 'dod pa yis// blo bzang dad pa cher byas 'jug /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras spangs nas// 'jig rten gzhan don la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// 'di las 'jig rten gzhan gyi min// de phyir 'jig rten gzhan dag gi

/dngos grub don du yid brtan gyis// zhes brjod pas/ rjes su nyan par gdams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ma lus dang*// rgyal ba mgon po kun gyi gnas// dbang phyug dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du// sta gon gnang bar mdzad du gsol// gsol ba btab/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa dpa' ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug bcad nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig/ zhes spro ba bskyed/ de nas 'chad par 'gyur ba bzhin/ thun mong spyi khyad par gyi sdom pa gzung nas/ slob ma dpal ye shes kyi mgon por bskyed pa'i snying gar hūm̐/ mgrin par āḥ dpral bar oṃ bsam zhing dri chu me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rjes reg /slar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs de dag la thim par bsam mo// nyer mchod lngas mchod/ de nas so shing byin nas maṇḍal tshoms bu lnga pa can la slob ma kha shar du phyogs pas badzra hā sa haḥ so la drud de steng nas dor bas de'i mgo bo gang du phyogs pa dang mthun par las 'grub par brda sprad/ de nas/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharma pā pā ni tsā sya bi sho dha ya sarba bi ka wā na a pa ya nā ya hūm̐/ dri'i chu khyor bar blug cing 'thung du gzhug lhag ma rgyab tu dor/

slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i srad bu sngo dmar gsum bsgril mdud pa gsum ldan la rtsa sngags bzlas te dpung pa g.yas la bcings/ oṃ buddha mai trī rakṣa rakṣa sarbā na swā hā/ zhes brjod/ yi ge hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha sngas dang*/ dhiḥlas byung ba'i oṃ badzra tikṣaṇya baṃ gyis stan du byin la/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ blo gros shin du mi g.yo na// de dag kun gyi ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pas// de ltar khyed rnams theg chen la// legs par skye bar 'gyur ba yin// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong ba na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes chos bshad/ khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang par ku sha'i stan dang sngas la seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis dug gsum gyi spros pa spangs te nyol/ bla ma yid la byed bzhin du rmi lam bsgug par gyis la bzang ngan gang mthong ba smros shig

ces nyal du gzhug mtshan ma ngan na spogs pa'i cho ga bya'o// sgrub pa chen po'i dngos gzhi la// thig tshon brlab gdab bri dgram dang*// rten 'dzug bsgrub dang bdag 'jug dang*// gzhan la dbang bskur de nyid du// dngos grub 'phrin las 'dod sbyar ro// gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i srad bu kha dog lnga/ sboms su nas kyi cha tsam ring thung dkyil 'khor bya rgyu nyis 'dab yod pa/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ thig tshon mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ kha dog lnga las rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi mgon po shes rab dang bcas pa thugs kar padma zla nyi kha sbyor gyi dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs chu gnyis nyer mchod dang bcas pas mchod/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i shlo kas bstod/ de dag zhu ba las thig skud du bsam ste/ slob dpon dang las kyi rdo rjes/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga teḥ sarba dharmaḥpa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ.a dyantu a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pa'i khu tshur g.yon pas gzung*/ slob ma nub tu phyogs pa'i khu tshur g.yas pas gzung ste/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang gung mos skud pa dang bcas pa'i se gol rdeb pa dang lhan cig nam mkha' la gdab/ thig 'debs dus/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas nam mkha' khyab pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug ste thim par bsam/ de bzhin du/ slob dpon lho dang bden bral du gnas nas/ tshangs thig gnyis pa zur thig rnams gdab/ nub tu gnas nas lho byang gi lhor gnas nas nub dang shar gyi rtsa thig rnams gdab cing*/ de nas las thig gdab/ 'di dang gong ma gnyis ka la slob dpon nub tu gnas nas me rlung gi mtshams nas phar mi 'da'/

slob ma shar dang byang du gnas nas me rlung gi mtshams nas tshur mi 'da'o// cha dbye ba ni/ tshangs gnas mnyam gsum phyi gshags cha// de nang dbus bzhag phyi phyed phyi// phyi chas nang ma'i mnyam pa byed// sgo la mnyam gcig phyed dang phyed// phyi yang gnyis bzhir steng de 'dra'i// mnga' sgo 'dzom steng gcig dbus gnyis// bskor skur dbus bzhag rtsa gnyis rtse// gcig 'dzom nas drug steng gsum bskor// thugs kyi rtsig nang phran gnyis khyams// gcig gnyis gcig gling nang gcig bskor// de nas gru gsum nang pad phyir// gnyis gsum gcig gcig cha bskor ba// tshon thig skud bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ lte ba mthing*/ 'dab ma phyogs mdog dang mdzes tshon/ gru gsum mthing*/ zla gam dmar/ mu khyud sngo/ gling nang ljang*/ mu khyud sngo/ phyi khyams dkar dmar/ rtsig pa phyi nas dkar sngo dmar ba/ snam bu dmar/ pha gu gser/ mun pa nag por dra phyed/ bya 'dab sngo la shar bu dkar ba/ mda' yab dkar po/ gsung gi khyams khrag mdog rtsig pa phyi nas dkar dmar sngo ba/ sku'i khyams ljang ser/ rtsig pa dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba/ khyams rnams la mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi ri mo/ phyi khyams ljang*/ pad 'dab sna tshogs/ dur khrod nag po/ rdo rwa sngon po/ mtshon cha dmar/ me ri sna lnga/ lha 'bur dod dam bris pa/ phyag mtshan nam/ sa bon nam/ mtha' tshon spungs kyi gdan dang bcas pa'i mtshan ma bya'o// de nas lda ldi mda' dar phye phur gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs dang dgra cha rgyan cha nor cha sogs spyan gzigs kyis kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du stegs bu'i khar bum pa sngar bzhin gyis gzhog pa'i tshe// hūm̐/ bum pa bkra shis yang dag ldan// rdo rje mgon po 'khor bcas pa// rang bzhin gnas nas bzhengs la 'dir// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol// de bzhin gtor ma bkod tshe/ hūm̐/ nus pa thogs med ba liṃ ta//

gzhan 'dra/ sku bris pa/ gsung sngags byang*/ thugs rten tsitta bla rdo dang bcas pa bkod tshe/ hūm̐/ sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can// phyag mtshan bkod tshe// hūm̐/ 'phrin las sna tshogs bdag nyid can// ka pā la/ hūm̐/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ni// gzhan rten dbang rdzas ci dgos pa thams cad/ hūm̐/ gsang ba sngags kyi brda yi lha// zhes pas bkod/ shar du chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga/ dkar skyems rgya ja/ byang sems 'byongs pa'i khrag 'o ma mtsho/ mtshan gyi khu ba/ bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib myang ba'i kha zas gtor ma zlum po/ lhor maṇḍal gling bzhi gling phran ri rab rol mtsho ri brgyad dang bcas pa/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ rin chen sna bdun/ gter bum ma smos pa'i lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba/ rgyal mtshan yod bzhin nor bu/ dar zab/ rin po che/ 'bru sna/ sman/ chang ser dang bcas pa'i dza gad kyi gser skyems/ zho 'byung ba rtsi'i khrag gis dmar ba/ shing tog sogs 'bru sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can/ nub nas gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro bda' ba/ reg bya 'jam pa/ rig pa'i lha mo bcu drug sgeg sogs brgyad sogs dang*/ sbrang chang la sogs pa'i mngar skyems/ padma rakta/ dbang du byed pa'i la du/ myos byed kyi 'bras bu la sogs pa las byas pa'i gtor ma zla gam gyi dbyibs can/ byang du/ dgra bo'i khrag gi arghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ mgo la sogs pa'i me tog gsur chen gyi spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ glang po che'i 'gi'u wang la sogs pa'i dri chu/ snying la sogs pa'i zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga sogs kyi rol mo// a mṛ ta sgog skya sbyar ba'i g.yu skyems/ bsgral ba'i rakta/ sha khrag rus pa 'bru nag po la sogs pa'i gtor ma dbang phyug chen po'i snying lta bu/ gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa thams cad kyis bskor la/ phyi rten g.yag rta lug khyi nag 'dzugs so// sgrub tshul bdag mdun bum pa gsum// dang po tshogs gnyis 'byung brtsegs gur// khro bo bskyed la mchod bstod bzlas// gzhal yas rgyu dus mngal 'byin glu// 'bras dus byin brlab ye shes dgug

/mchod gzhug dbang dang rgyas btab dang*// phyag mchod bdud rtsi myang dang bstod// 'dzab dang ting 'dzin nyer bsdu'o// bdag nyid skad cig gis ye shes mgon po yab yum du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma/ de dbus hūm̐ mthing nag ye shes lngar 'bar ba'i 'od kyi lcags kyus rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma lhag pa'i lha steng du bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs sems/ badzra muḥrang la bstim/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sems cad thams cad bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par bya'o// zhes/ sems cad thams cad kyi ched du dpal he ru ka thob par bya'o// snyam smon pa'i sems bskyed nas/ 'jug pa ni/

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmā ཿswa bhā wa shuddhonya haṃ/ gzung ba'i chos thams cad mi dmigs/ oṃ badzra shuddhāḥsarba dharmā ཿswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dha rmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ chos thams cad gzung 'dzin dang bral ba rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid tsam gyi ngo bor bltas la/ smon lam gyi dbang gis sems de nyid gong nas gong du gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po/ de gsum las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu nas de gsum la thim/ oṃ āḥl āḥhūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi u ni ha'i khog pa la/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la thim/ de nyid je phra je phrar gyur pas skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshags pa tsam du gnas pa de las/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ bhūṃ paṃ ha rnams steng nas steng du 'ched/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes nas/ lngas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ bhūṃ las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og dang bcas pa'i rtsibs bcu pa dpag pa'i yul las 'das pa'i lte bar nyi ma la bdud bzhi brtsegs pa dang*/ rtsibs rnams la nyi ma dang so so'i phyogs skyong gi gdan la hūm̐ yig 'bar ba re re/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lte bar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sngon po dbus sngo g.yon dkar g.yas dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum na dril bu thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ mer mi g.yo ba mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/

phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dgra sta zhags pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dbyug par ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ bden bral du 'dod ba'i rgyal po mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa lcags kyu/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ nub tu padma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum padma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dgra sta zhags pa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ rlung du dbyug pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa dang ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub zhags pa dgra sta/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon pau sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan can/ dbang ldan du stobs po che nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rtse gsum/ dgra sta/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor spyi bor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje padma/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan can/

'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub padma ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ de thams cad kyang shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing drag po'i gad rgyangs can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan dmar po gsum gzir zhing sma ra ag tshoms mer 'bar ba/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dpa' gyi chas kyis brgyan te/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas phyogs skyong brdzis te me'i phung po'i nang du kha phyir bstan te bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa la/ oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hū?m̐ swā hā/ sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ drag shul chen po lha yi lha// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po// khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ āḥbadzra kro dha rā dza hūm̐ ka ra/ ya manta kṛ ta/ a tsa la/ pradzñānta kṛta/ ṭakki rā dza/ padmanta kṛ ta/ nī la daṇḍa/ bighnanta kṛta/ mahā ba la/ uṣṇi ṣa tsa kra warti/ sumbha rā dza/ de shi rakṣaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes khro bo rnams brtan par bya ba'i phyir lan bdun bzlas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi lto ba yangs pa dpag tu med pa'i nang du/ oṃ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad ces nas/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma'i gdan la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ li lī/ e āai/ o āau/ aṃ a/ lan gnyis brjod/ de gcig g.yas dang*/ cig shos g.yon du 'khor bas mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbyangs de dag gis mtshan pa/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa tha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥḍā dha/ da dha/ ya la/

lan gnyis/ de gcig g.yas dang*/ cig shos g.yon du 'khor bas dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gsal byed de dag gis mtshan pa/ de gnyis kyi dbus su nam mkhar gnas pa'i nā da zhugs/ de las thig le/ de las mgo bo/ de las ha'i khog pa/ de las ring po dang bcas pa'i zhabs kyu mched pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag du rdzogs pa/ dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pa las/ 'gro ba thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs su bkod nas/ phyogs bcu'i thogs ma med pa nas grub pa'i dam can rgya mtsho thams cad thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba zhu ba dang lhan cig slar 'dus pa hūm̐ gi nā da la thim pas mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin zla ba gnyis hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje gri gug de yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po zhes pa nas/ tsan 'khyil gyis bzhugs pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ sbyor yum gyi mkha' ā las padma 'dab brgyad āḥmatshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i mgon po lcam dral/ zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro las byed dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad nā dar gyur pa bdag gi spyi bor zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ rdo rje'i khar 'thon yum gyi padmar lhung ba sku gsung thugs kyi lha'i tshogs dang grangs mnyam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thig le'i dbus rlung dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ā li kā li las zla ba kha sbyor gyi bar du zhugs/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer spros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs bsdus te de nyid la thim/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po

zhes nas/ thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs thams cad gsal btab/ de nas gtso bo yab yum bzhi/ yab kyi dbu ma nas gyen du song*/ snying ka nas phyir phyung ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gdug pa ma lus pa 'dul zhing bstan pa rgyas par mdzad de/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba la thim ma thag tu bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad 'joms pa la shin tu drag por gyur/ gzhan rnams mngal nas rim pa bzhin 'thon nas dkyil 'khor chen por rim pa ji lta bas bzhugs par gyur/ de nas gtso bo yab yum blta ba dang*/ rgod pa dang*/ rjes su chags pa'i sbyor bas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu ba dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bur gyur pa lha mo bzhis gdung bas tshad med pa bzhi'i dbyangs gyis bskul ba/ 'di snyam nas ni yang dag ston pa po// skye ba'i mun pa bcom nas ring du bzhud// yan lag 'byor pa'i dbang phyug 'dzin pa 'di// nges par 'byung ba byung ba de nyid la// rtag par bzhugs shing pha rol 'gro ma byed// kun tu yang dag byed pa chen po yi// mi snang snang ba de thos mnyam par ston// da ni ston pa rgyun chad ma bzhugs shig /chen po de ltar ston pa sdig med mdog /sgyu ma gzhan gyis smon zhes skye med bzhengs// zhes bskul bas thugs rje chen pos chu las nya ldang ba lta bur skad cig gis gtso bo gsang ba'i yum chen gsum dang bcas pa sngar bzhin bzhengs par gyur/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ zhes pa nas/ 'dzab kyi bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa'i yi ge ji bzhin/ bzlas pa tshar nas/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i snang ba las mi g.yo ba'i sems rtse gcig pa bsgrub/ bdag bskyed rkyang pa byed na badzra muḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas yum dang bcas pa'i rten brten par bcas pa thams cad bdag gi snying kar bsdus la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/ye shes mgon po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yis sa la 'god par shog/ ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos te mgon po'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug mdun bskyed dang 'brel na mi bsdu bar/ mdun bskyed dam tshig bskyed pa la// ye shes sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsre// dbang bskur ba nas bzlas pa'i bar// bsnyen pa bzhin du bya ba yin// mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rten rdzas dbang rdzas thams cad bsang gtor byas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta zhes nas/ srid pa gsum za bar chas pa zhes pa'i bar te sgrub pa ji lta ba la/ bdag bskyed kyi yab kyi gsang gnas zhes nas/ thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo chen por gyur pa yum padma nas phyir 'thon pa dang*/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bcas pa mdun du bskyed pa'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo la ji lta ba bzhin du thim/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ nas bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa la 'phrin las rgyas pa bsnan pa bzhin byas/ de nas sngar bzhin du bum bskyed byas/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dang*/ slob ma'i rnams rang gir shes pas 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi bdag 'jug blang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur na/ bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa de yis mgon po khyod// bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod// ces pa brjod/ dbang la sngon 'gro 'jug pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur rjes yon 'bul// 'jug pa phyi nang gsang ba'i dang*// khrus dang maṇḍal gsol btab sdom// bcing bskon gtsug tor me tog 'dzin// dri lan sems bskyed gnyis pa 'khrid// bskor dang phyag bya gsum pa la// dam bzhag bzhi dang gsol dbab dang*// spogs gshegs dri go bsang brlab dor// brda sprad bcing dkrol dkyil 'khor bstan// lhag gnas kyi dus kyi slob ma rnams yol ba'i phyir khrus byas maṇḍal phul te gsol ba 'debs pa/

mgon po khyod la gang gsol ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che// dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yi// go cha'i mchog ni bshad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs thun mong dang*/ rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pas// rtag tu brten cing spyad par bya// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// zhes spyi dang*/ yang dag bla ma bsten par bya// 'dir ni byang chub sems kyi ni// bsnyen pa nye bar bsnyen pa dang*// sgrub pa sgrub pa chen po yi// khyad par rim pa rtags dang dus// las la sbyor ba shes par bya// zhes bye brag gi sdom pa 'dzin pa lan gsum gyis khas blangs la/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs bzlas pa'i dar dmar pos gdong bcing*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ bzlas pa'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bskon/ oṃ badzra uṣṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa bzlas pa'i gtsug tor byas/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin du bcug 'jug yon phul te dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir/ kye dga' ba la dga' ba khyod su yin/ zhes dri/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags// zhes lan brjod/ de nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta u pa ta ya mi/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed du bcug me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying kar reg ste/ oṃ su ra ste sa ma ya staṃ hoḥsi dhya badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje la 'dzin du bcug āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis yol ba'i nang du mtshan ma mthong ba'i las kyi rdo rjes 'khrid/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor ma// rdo rje nag po chen po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lha// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis dkyil 'khor la g.yas su bskor ba byas nas/ dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo dang*// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro ma// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid la// gus pa mchog gis phyag 'tshal zhing*// skyabs su nges par mchi lags kyis// bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol//

shar nas sgo bzhir rim pa bzhin zhugs nas padma'i lag bskor sngon du 'gro bas me tog 'thor zhing phyag bya'o// na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ deng khyod dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal ma hā kā la'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan ci smos/ dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon/ rdo rje snying kar gtug ma hā kā la deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// nyes dmigs kyi/ mna' chu blud/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// ces phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis kas/ de nas rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi ma hā kā la nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyes par yang ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/

zhes slob dpon bka' gnyan po'i sgo nas dam la bzhag bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la dpal he ru ka ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po'i byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ spu pags sha rus rkang te ro'i yan lag lnga rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mar khu chen po dang*/ gu gul chen po ste sman sna bdun dang*/ chang la gu gul nag po sbyar ba'i ril bu yum gyi sngags bzlas pa'i dud par bdug rol mo drag po bya/ rgyas par 'dod na 'dzab bro'i gsol ba 'debs so byin chen dbab tu gsol gdags pa bya/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun/ ngag rlung bum pa can 'ching*/ yid shin tu 'dod thag nye zhing ma yengs pas dag pa'i sngags brjod/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis mgon po phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa can me dpung 'bar ba'i nang nyi zla'i steng na gar mdzad pa/ bla ma mgon po yab yum du bzhugs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang grub pa'i gnas nas thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa nam mkha' las sprin chad pa'am kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byung nas so so'i lus la thim par bsams te/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la ā be sha ya a a/ des ma phebs na so so'i lus kyi lte bar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa gar mdzad cing*/ bla ma dang gtso bo'i 'od zer gyis gnas gsum gyi ḍā ki thams cad bkug ste/ ba spu'i khung nas zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par mos te/ oṃ mahā kā la ya/ wa pa sha ya/ ḍā ki ni kā ya wa ka tsitta badzrā nāṃ ā be sha ya a a/ ma phebs na lan gsum du bskyar/

des kyang ma phebs na re zhig sdig pa sbyong du bcug de res la dbang bskur du mi btub bo// babs pa'i rtags byung na tiṣṭha badzra zhes rdo rje rgya gram du bkod pas brtan par bya/ rnam 'gyur ma zhi na oṃ tiṣṭha sa ma sa pa ri ba li te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swāhā/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag gshegs su gsol lo// dkyil 'khor bltar bcug la mig sngar ci snang zhes dri kha dog gi dbye bas las so so grub pa go bar bya'o// dris slob ma bsangs nas/ 'dzab bro dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor/ sngar bzung ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyis bsngags te thal mo'i bar du byin la slob dpon gyis/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'dir// bdag gis slob ma 'jug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /brjod pa'i mthar pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ dkyil 'khor du dor/ de nas/ me tog gang du lhung gyur ba// de ni khyod kyi rigs kyi lha// zhes brda sprad/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa twaṃ mi maṃ mahā ba la/ zhes pas me tog gi 'phreng ba pad bskor gyis blangs te gang la babs pa'i lha de nyid kyis slob ma de'i mgo bor bcings par bsam mo// de nas// rdo rje nag po deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// zhes gdong g.yogs bkrol// he badzra pā she/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// ces brjod/ de nas/ dam tshig gsang ba rmad du byung*// rgyal ba rin chen 'bar ba'i gtso// phyogs dus med par rang byung ba// chos 'byung pho brang dkyil 'khor du// rigs kyi yon tan ldan par ni// nam mkha' rgya mtsho 'bras ldan pa// phun sum tshogs pa lhun gyis grub// zhes lha'i de nyid dang*/ mi phyed lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyal// pho brang gsang ba'i gzhal yas khang*//

zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid bstan cing dag pa bshad do// 'jug pa'o// dbang bskur bum gsang shes rab tshig /slob dpon bcas yin snga ma la// gsol btab bgegs sbyang rigs lnga'i dbang*// rjes gnang 'dogs bcas phyir mi ldog /bum rgyan tsaka li sku dang 'phreng*// sngags sbyin dril gsung bsgom rdor thugs// dngos grub yon tan 'phrin las mthu// lha tshogs sku gsung thugs rjes gnang*// 'dogs drug 'di la bshad pa yin// rigs lnga'i dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ma lus dang*// rgyal ba mgon po kun gyi gnas// dbang phyug dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur gnang bar mdzad du gsol// de nas yungs kar lag pa g.yas g.yon du gzung la so sor lan gnyis su g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badzrā ya/ badzra sa twa sya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swāhā/ zhes bzlas shing yungs kar me la dor/ yang g.yas su bskor bas kyang ngo*// de bzhin du chu dang*/ kham phor dang*/ dur ba dang bcas pa'i ba lci'i chang bu dang*/ zan changs dang*/ seng ras kyis kyang byab ste mer ni mi 'dor ro// de nas lag pa nye reg byas la/ snying kar dri dang*/ mgo la me tog mdun du yon chab/ mar mes bskor zhing mar dang spos dkar bdugs te phyir dor ro// de ni bgegs dang sdig pa dang mi shis pa sbyang ba'o// de nas slob ma dbang stegs su bzhag las thams cad pa'i chu 'thor/ oṃ swa bhā wa/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur pa'i rdo rje'i zhing khams chen po'i dbus su padma nyi zla'i gdan la hūm̐ 'od zer gyi don gnyis byas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po zhe sdang rdo rje bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad sgrol ba'i las la myur ba rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo pho nya bka' sdod thams cad kyis bskor ba skad cig gis gsal thob/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum chen rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ mgon po rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ pho nya bka' sdod kyi tshogs kyis bgegs skrod pa ra bsams la/ me long ye shes bdag nyid can// rdo rje'i rigs kyi mgon po yis// dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du ni// zhe sdang dag pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dngos su bum pa gzhan rnams kyi chu rnam rgyal du blug de spyi bor dkor cing 'thung du gzhug bsang sbyang*/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur pa'i rin po che'i zhing khams chen po'i dbus su/ mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje rgyas pa'i byin chags pa rin po che'i rigs/ mnyam nyid ye shes bdag nyid can// rin chen/ nga rgyal/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna a bhi ṣiñtsha trāṃ/ dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa mgo la bskon/ bsang sbyang*/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i padma'i zhing*/ mgon po chags pa'i rdo rje dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ padma'i rigs thams cad kyi/ sor rtog ye shes bdag nyid can// padma'i/ 'dod chags/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥdabang bskur/ tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ rdo rje lag pa g.yas par gtad/ bsang sbyang*/ nyon mongs phrag dog 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i zhing*/ mgon po 'phrin las thams cad pa'i rdo rje mthu dang stobs kyi dbang phyug chen po/ las kyi rigs kyi/ bya ba nan tan bdag nyid can// las kyi/ phrag dog oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ dbang bskur/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ dril bu g.yon par gtad/ bsang sbyang*/

nyon mongs pa gti mug gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i 'khor lo'i zhing*/ mgon po rtag pa'i rdo rje zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ 'khor lo'i rigs thams cad kyi/ chos dbyings ye shes bdag nyid can// 'khor lo'i/ gti mug oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa bhruṃ/ dbang bskur/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ me tog phog pa dang mthun pa ming btags/ de nas 'phrin las bzhi'i 'jam rdor sogs mgon po rigs bzhir rim pa bzhin bsgoms nas/ thog mar bai ta'i 'bras bu gtad la/ hūm̐/ skal ldan khyod kyi gdul bya la// sna tshogs longs spyod 'phel byed pa// phan dang bde ba kun gyi gzhi// rgyas pa'i 'phrin las 'grub gyur cig /oṃ badzra mahā kā la puṣṭiṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas thod pa gtad la/ hūm̐/ mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi gnas// thod pa ant+ras bkang ba 'di// 'gro ba rjes su gzung ba'i phyir// dbang gi 'phrin las 'grub gyur cig /oṃ badzra mahā kā la wa shaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa baṃ/ ral gri gtad la/ hūm̐/ gdug pa ma rungs 'dul byed cing*// bdud las rnam par rgyal ba yi// 'bar ba'i ral gri rnon po 'dis// drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub gyur cig /mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hoḥ kha ṭwāṃ ga gtad la/ hūm̐/ lus ngag yid gsum nyes pa rnams// rab zhi rtse gsum 'bar ba yis// ye shes sku gsum rtogs gyur nas// zhi ba'i 'phrin las 'grub gyur cig /shānti a bhi ṣiñtsa dzaḥ gri gug gtad nas/ hūm̐/ rengs dang khrag 'dren rnam gnon dang*// brgyal dang smyor 'jug rnam par rmongs// dbye dang bskrad la sogs pa yis// 'phrin las thams cad 'grub gyur cig /slob ma bsang sbyang*/ nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa rnam par sbyangs/ phung po khams skye mched thams cad gnas gyur pa'i longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gnas 'og min gyi zhing khams chen po'i dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/

bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khrag 'thung thams cad kyi spyi/ ma hā kā la'i rigs thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur ba mgon po chen po zhes nas/ sgrol yum dang bcas mngon rtogs bzhin gsal btab/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ nas/ sa mā dza'i bar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nas / du ma dang ldan pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// de ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ chus gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag slob dpon gyi bya ba la dbang bar byas te lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil/ dpal 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje yan lag ma dang lhan cig bzhugs pas dbu brgyan par gyur// phyag rgya lnga/ sbrul brgyad/ thod skam mgo bo'i ga sha thams cad sbyin te/ hūm̐/ bdud dang log 'dren tshar bcad cing*// ma traṃ ru dra bsgral ba'i dus// dpal gyi sku la mdzes pa'i rgyan// bstan pa bsrung phyir gdags par gyis// zhes pas lus la gyon/ de bzhin bgo ba'i gos gsum byin nas/ gos bgo par gyis/ byug pa'i rdzas gsum byug cing*/ dpa' gyi sku la mdzes pa'i rdzas// bstan pa bsrung phyir byug par bgyi// de nas sku'i tsaka li mig dor byin te/ hūm̐/ sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul ba dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas bya'i phyir// de ring rigs kyi skal ldan la// sgyu ma lta bu'i sku bstan no// oṃ shrī mahā kā la badzra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dri ma med pa'i shel dar sna tshogs la bzhag pa lta bur/

dpal ye shes mgon po'i sku gcig gang gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i phyag rgyar rol pas sems can gyi don gyis shig/ sku'i dbang ngo*// 'phreng ba mi mgo'i 'phreng bar mos pa byed du bcug/ hūm̐/ dngos po'i rnam rtog bcom pa yis// sna tshogs mgo yi 'phreng ba 'di// bdud dang mu stegs tshar bcod dang*// yon tan rgyas phyir gzung bar gyis// slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rtsa sngags rnams sha ra ra byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga gnad 'byed pa'i sgo nas zhugs/ tsitta rin po che'i gur khyim du nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ yig 'bar ba'i mthar 'khor ba'i mos pa gyis/ gtso bo'i sngags kyi rjes gnang byin/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi blud/ dril bu rna bar dkrol nas/ hūm̐/ bla med sku gsum dngos grub kyis// gsang sngags brjod du med pa'i don// nus pa mchog gi gter 'gyur pa// dril bu dbyangs rjes rnal 'byor gzung*// oṃ shrī mahā kā la badzra wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzung sngags snying po'i chos kyi ganḍi rnal mar bzhag pa dgra dang sprod pa/ grogs dang sdeb pa/ mnan pa/ dbyung ba/ dkrug pa/ 'phrul du bskor ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgra tshul gyis brdungs la sems can gyi don gyis shig/ gsung gi dbang ngo*// lus ngag rnal du phab/ sems bde ba chen por bstim/ cung zhig bzhag de nas/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// khams gsum po ni ma lus pa// 'gro kun sgyu ma lta bu yin// gshis stong pa nyid yin pas rtsal rkyen gyis bsgyur na ci dga' bar 'char du btub pa yin te na ma mkha' bzhin/ rtsal de yang lha sngags ting nge 'dzin ci dang cir langs kyang snang tsam ste de dang de'i dngos po zhig tu med pas na sgyu ma la sgyu ma mkhan bzhin rol zhig

rdo rje thugs kar gzung la/ hūm̐/ thugs rje chen pos don 'grub cing*// ye shes mi g.yo rnal 'byor pas// 'gag med brtul zhugs chen po yis// rdo rje mi 'gyur dbang bskur ro// oṃ shri mahā kā la badzra bo dhi tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ thugs kyi dbang ngo*// de nas 'bod rten g.yab dar/ sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul ba dang*/ nas/ skal ldan la// 'bod pa'i rten rdzas ma lus sbyin// zhi ba'i mchod pa chu gnyis rnam lnga rol mo sman rag gtor ma/ sprul pas= sangs rgyas= de ring= zhi ba'i mchod rdzas= de bzhin rgyas pa bkra shis rdzas brgyad rin chen sna bdun gling bzhi ri rab sogs bkod pa'i manḍal sman raka gtor gsum/ sprul pas= sangs rgyas= de ring= rgyas pa'i/ 'dod yon lnga/ sman raka gtor ma/ sprul pas= sangs rgyas= de ring= dbang gi= dur khrod chen po'i mchod yon sogs dang sman raka gtor ma/ sprul pas= sangs rgyas= de ring= drag po'i mchod= phyi rten g.yag lug sogs bris pa dang*/ nang rten bla rdo/ gsang rten grir shi ba'i snying rnams ni sprul pas= sangs rgyas= de ring= rten pa'i dam rdzas ma lus spyin/ de nas lag pa g.yon du kā pā la bdud rtsi blug pa gtad/ g.yas su rdo rje gri gug gis thod khrag dkrugs pa'i tshul du byas nas lce thog tu bdud rtsi/ mdun du tshogs/ rten gtor spyi bor bzhag la/

hūm̐/ ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyi// bla na med pa dbang bskur bas// mchod dang thun mong thams cad kyi// dngos grub myur du thob gyur cig /oṃ badzra mahā kā la gu ṇa siddhi pha la hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas yon tan gyi dbang ngam dngos grub blang ba sbyin/ de nas phur pa gtad de/ hūm̐/ las rnams bsgrub cing bstan pa bsrung*// rnal 'byor 'phrin las dbang byed pas/ nus pas tshar bcad phur pa yis// mi gnas gnang ba sbyin par bya// oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da badzra kī li kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ phur pa las mgon du bsam/ mdun du brub khung gnam lcags kyi khang par dgra po ā karṣa ya dzaḥ nya'u dgra lcags kyus snying phug zhags pas ske bcings/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams/ dril bu dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis mnyes pa/ las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas 'phul/ 'jigs pa'i mun nag la mdun phyogs pa'i nyam shin tu thag pa zhig tu gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la shag phye shag phye ma ma trag ru dra mā ra ya rbad/ de 'go ba'i lha dang phral/ oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da badzra kā+-i li kī la ya a mu ka mā ra ya rbad/ phur skor byed du bcug phur pa las 'od zer 'phros/ de la 'phog pas de'i bsrung ba/ byin rlabs/ rang bzhin gyi kha sbyar dbye/ tshe srog gi lhag ma bsdus nas bdag la thim rnam shes nri phur rtser blangs dbal du bsregs/ dwangs ma hūm̐ du gyur pa rgya mdud nas 'thon nas 'og min du song bar gyur pa'i mos pa gyis byas bzhi snying bsgrag gnas lngar bsnun du bcug bcad cing gtubs sha khrag tsho tshogs su rol bar bya'o// 'phrin las kyi dbang ngo*// de nas yum chen ma mo'i srog dbang rgyas par 'dod na gzhan du bshad pa bzhin nam/ mdor bsdus pa/ khyed rang dbyings yum rang bzhin gyis gnas pa/ sbyor yum rnam pa la 'char ba/ sgrol yum byed las su bsgrub pas ngo bo gcig ldog pa tha dad par snang ba skad cig gis gsal thob/

hūm̐/ rnam thar gsum gzugs sher phyin yum chen mo// dbyings sbyor sgrol mdzad sku gsung thugs gsum dang*// skal ldan 'di yi lus ngag yid thams cad// gnyis med ye shes chen por dbang bskur ro// oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li mahā kā li kā ya wā ka tsitta a dhiṣṭha na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes sku'i tsaka li spyi bor bzhag steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas ye shes kyi ma bu yug 'tshub pa ltar 'ongs pa de la bstim pa sku'i rjes gnang*/ snying po gsum zlos su gzhug thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin pa gsung*/ phyag mtshan bla rdo rnams gtad/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten las dang mthun par 'jug pa'i tshe// dgra bgegs srod dang dbugs la myur rol pa'i// dregs pa lha yis phyag rgya 'di byin pas// 'phrin las thams cad thogs med 'grub gyur cig/ zhes thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ de bzhin rigs 'dre bas/ nga rgyal dag pas lha mo re ma ti/ gti mug dag pas klu/ zhe sdang dag pas bdud/ 'dod chags dag pas gnod sbyin re ma tir gsal thob/ hūm̐/ 'dod dgur bsgyur pa'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che// re ti mched bzhi'i sku gsung thugs gsum dang*/ oṃ de wi kā ya sogs/ hūm̐ mdzad ye shes kyi mgon por/ hūm̐/ hūm̐ mdzad mgon po chen po phyag gnyis pa// rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs gsum dang*// hūm̐/ gsang ba'i mgon po chen po gdong bzhi pa// sems dpa' chen po'i/ hūm̐/ myur mdzad mgon po chen po phyag drug pa// dam tshig sems dpa'i/ hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ma dang zhi byed srung byed ma// ye shes ma mo'i/ hūm̐/ las kyi mgon po chen po bya rog gdong*// 'jigs byed nag po'i/ de'i yum tsaṇḍi ka dmar mo/ hūm̐/ skye 'gro yongs kyi ma gcig tsaṇḍi ka 'bar gdong dmar mo'i/ hūm̐/ gsod byed mgon po chen po bya rog gdong*// tshe bdag nag po'i/ hūm̐/ rngam byed mgon po chen po bya rog gdong*// srog bdag nag po'i/

hūm̐/ sgrol byed mgon po chen po bya rog gdong*// 'chi bdag nag po'i hūm̐/ sha za ma dang khrag 'thug rtsa 'jib ma// 'jig rten ma mo'i/ hūm̐/ 'khor lo sku yi mgon po stag zhon che// nag po yab yum/ mahā kā la/ hūm̐/ padma gsung gi mgon po tshogs bdag che// hūm̐/ rdo rje thugs kyi mgon po 'bar ba che// hūm̐/ rin chen yon tan mgon po legs ldan che// hūm̐/ sna tshogs 'phrin las mgon po gri gug che// hūm̐/ dmod pa drag sngags mgon po beng chen po// hūm̐/ ma mo rbod gtong mgon po ma ning che// hūm̐/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i mgon po tra ka shad che// ye shes lha mo gang 'dul gyi sku brgyad du 'char bzhin par sgoms shig hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro'i gzugs can gar yang thogs med pa// lha mo brgyad kyi/ sgo brgyad gnas nyer bzhi zhing skyong gi rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi zhing skyong so gnyis dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal thob/ hūm̐/ khyod la sku gsung thugs nyid dang*// mthu stobs nus pa rdzu 'phrul sogs// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub kun// myur du thob pa'i dbang skur ro// srid pa'i bdag mo dang ber nag can lcam dral gsal thob/ bhyoḥ srid bdag chen mo rang byung rgyal mo dang*// ber nag lcam dral/ bhyoḥ yid kyi re skong bkra shis tshe ring dang*// tshogs bdag lcam dral/ bhyoḥ e ka dzā ṭ-i g.yu yi sgrol ma dang*// rta nag lcam dral/ bhyoḥza byed chen mo dur khrod bdag mdzad pa// zhing skyong lcam dral= so so'i sku skad cig gis gsal btab/ sku bstim pa/ snying po gtad pa/ bla rdo phyag mtshan sbyin pa rnams bya'o// slob dpon gyis tsaka li gtad/ hūm̐/ gu lang chen po dbang phyug lha yi lha// btsun mo nang mi mngag gzhug dmag gi sdes// skal ldan dam ldan rigs kyi bu 'di la// zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub kun stsol cig oṃ badzra mahā kā la a trig nan/

e hur thuṃ dzaḥm ra ya rbad/ zhes gzir bas lha'i sde dpon chen po 'khor bcas rang dbang med par slob ma mgon por gsal ba la 'dud cing lus bran du bkod srog snying phul bar bsam zlos su bcug phyag mtshan gtod pa'i tshe/ hūm̐/ snyigs ma lnga ldan dus 'di ru// dam tshig 'dzin pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// khyed kyi bstan pa bdag gis bsrung*// 'phrin las ci bsgo bsgrub par bya// yid ci bsgo ba nyan no snyam pas rang rtags phul ba ra bsam mo// de ltar rigs 'dre bas/ hūm̐/ seng ge'i gdong can nag po bdud kyi bdud// du trig nan/ hūm̐/ las kyi gshin rje chen po chos kyi rgyal// ya trig nan/ hūm̐/ dug gi spu gri gza' mchog ra hu la// ra trig nan/ hūm̐/ nā ga rakṣa gdug pa klu yi bdud// phu trig nan/ hūm̐/ skyes bu beg rtse sgrol ba'i ging chen po// tsa trig nan/ hūm̐/ zhang 'on rdo rje bdud 'dul khrag ral can// kṣa trig nan/ hūm̐/ stod kyi mi bo chen po dmu rje btsan// tsa trig nan/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal po chen po bzhi// tri trig nan/ thun mong du mnan gtad kyi rdzas gtad/ hūm̐/ bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs// las kyi gshin rje'i khar gtad nas// sa 'og rim pa dgur 'ching ba'i// mnan gtad las kyi dbang bskur ro// mnan gtad kyi sngags/ dgang blugs gtad/ hūm̐/ zhi rgyas dbang drag thab khung du// las dang ye shes lha dmigs nas// phyi dang gsang ba'i rdzas thams cad// sreg pa hom gyi dbang thob shog /sreg sngags brjod/ dmar gtor mchod dus gtor ma/ sgrub dus khang pa/ bskul dus lha 'phang dus su gzer du shes par gyis shig byas te/ hūm̐/ dregs pa thams cad dbang sdud phyir// dam tshig rjes su 'dzin byed pa// gtor ma'i gsang ba sbyin pa 'dis// dus kun mchod dang 'phang bar gyis// oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa ma ya ba liṃ a bhi ṣ-iñtsa hūm̐/

bzhi snying gcig dril gyi bzlas lung byin/ thun rdzas bcu dregs pa las la 'chos par shes par gyis gtad nas/ hūm̐/ dregs pa'i sde dpon khros pa'i mtsho// dgra bo'i lus srog 'grel ba'i 'khyug /drag sngags dmod pa'i gnam lcags thog /ma rungs 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ro// lidga la zor rnams brdeg tu 'jug cing gzhung bzhin gyis byin/ bum dbang ngo*// de nas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor brtsams nas gsang dbang ni/ maṇḍal gsol bcings 'bul sbyor phyung*// thig khar byin dkrol dbang don bshad// maṇḍal phul/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'gro ba'i mgon// ngag gi dri ma dag pa dang*// gsung gi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i gdong bcings/ slob mas rig ma phul/ de dang slob dpon gnyis gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ lus ngag yid gsum mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa byas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs rjes chags kyi mes bzhu ba rdo rje nor bu'i rtser lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba brtan par byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu sogs brjod/ de nas phyir phyung ba'i khrag dang khu ba la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum bzlas/ spyi gtsug smin mtshams mgrin snying bzhir thig le bya/ chos dbyings rnam dag yum gyi mkha'// ye shes rang gsal yab kyi gsang*// gnyis med bde chen byang chub sems// bdud rtsi'i bcud chen myang bar byos// zhes khar mtheb srin gyis sbyin zhing*/ slob mas kyang bdud rtsi myangs te/ a ho mahā su khaṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas shes rab mas kyang padmar gnas pa'i sbrang rtsi de bzhin du byin nas gdong g.yogs bkrol/ brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi// 'gro ba dmigs su med pa ste// mthong ba dang ni thos la sogs// thams cad sgyu ma lta bur 'char// de yang so so rang rigs par gnas pa'i ngo na ci yang snang ba med la/

rjes kyi shes par ni des bden pa'i dbal bcom pa'i phyir sgyu ma tsam du 'char bas mnyam bzhag tu ci yang mi dmigs pa dang*/ rjes thob tu snang ba thams cad zung du 'brel bar khyer nas gong nas gong du dpa' bar 'gro bar gyis shig ces brda sprad do// maṇḍal gsol bcings phyag rgya gtad// lha bskyed byin brlab sbyor nas bkrol// de nas dbang gsum pa'i don du maṇḍal phul/ mgon po thugs kyi rang bzhin can// sems kyi dri ma dag pa dang*// thugs kyi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang phyag rgya'i gdong bcings/ gang gis skye bo 'ching 'gyur ba// de nyid yongs shes rnam par grol// phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni// sa gsum bde ba chen por bsgyur// zhes dbang rten mtshan nyid ldan pa'i phyag rgya slob ma la gtad/ de nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i gnas gsum mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ gnyis shor gnyis mnyam gyi dbus su rnam par smin pa'i dga' ba mthong gi bar du snyoms par 'jug tu bcug de nas yid nang du chud pa de nyid dam bla ma'i man ngag gis zla ba phyir mi 'dzag par byas te gdong g.yogs bkrol/ maṇḍal gsol btab dbang don no/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul/ dpa' ldan gsang ba he ru ka /gzung 'dzin gnyis med bde ba che// ngo bo nyid sku thob bya'i phyir// bdag la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur stsol// gsol ba btab/ de nas gdong g.yogs bcings/ /nyon mongs med na ye shes med// nyan rang byang chub lam la ring*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// 'byung ba bzhi la sogs pa rnams// thams cad gdod nas dag pa yi// ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// dngos po du ma gsal bar snang*// ye shes med par skye mi 'gyur// sangs rgyas ye shes kyis rab skul// de bas bla med rgyud 'di ru// 'bad de dad pa bskyed par bya// gsang ba'i sdom pa bla na med//

de yang phyag rgya chen po'i rjes su chags pa med par 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba thob pa med pas nyan rang rnams byang chub kyi lam la ring la/ phyag rgya chen po la rjes su chags pas 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba thob pa de nyid sangs rgyas te rnam pa med bzhin du rnam pa thams cad par 'char bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'am zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa de ni dbang bzhi pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gam sdom pa chen po'o// zhes brda sprad/ gdong g.yogs bkrol// maṇḍal gsol btab slob dpon bya// po ti lung sbyin brtul zhugs gnyis// rdo rje slob dpon gyi don du maṇḍal phul/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'joms pa po// rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid che// myur du dngos grub ster byed stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i 'og tu seng ge'i khri/ steng du gdugs/ rkang 'og 'khor lo/ lag pa gnyis bsnol bar rdo rje dang dril bu byin te/ bsam pa gang dang gang dag gis// mi rnams sems dang mthun par 'jug /de dang de yi gzugs sprul te// sna tshogs g.yogs te bde bar bzhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra tsārya a tiṣṭhā ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas po ti lung sbyin gyi phyir dung dang*/ rgyud man ngag gi po ti dang*/ rdo rje rnams gtad la/ padma rgyas pa g.yas 'khyil dung*// chos bdag so so rigs pa mchog /dri med dpa' bo rdo rje ni// mi phyed bde chen ye shes so// zhes brjod dpa' bo'i rim pa'i brtul zhugs dbang gi phyir cang te'u kha ṭwām̐ ga thod pa rnams byin nas/ yang dag don ldan mchog don du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtul zhugs kyis// gsang ba 'dzin par byed pa dang*// nam yang 'bral ba ma byed cig/ gar 'chams kyi chas des byin no// rang byin gyis brlab pa'i mtha'i brtul zhugs kyi ched du/ rdo rje lag tu gtad/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu stobs rdo rjes phyag na rdo rjer dbang bskur ba ltar du khyed rang rnams la yang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis/ sgo gsum nus mthu ldan pa yis// gsang ba gsum gyi rdo rjer bsgrub// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ltar// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis// yon tshogs bsdu dang bsngo dang shis// rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba yin// zhes gtang rag gi yon dang maṇḍal phul/ tshogs la rol ba man bsnyen pa bzhin no// de nas gser skyems kyi tshig mtha' ma'i tshab// gsol ba 'debs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol zhes pa'i mthar 'dzab bro dang bcas dkyil 'khor la ci nus bskor zhing*/ de nas/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha yi tshogs// sku yi dngos grub bdag la zhu// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i lus// 'grub nas 'gro don rgyas par shog/ de bzhin gsung thugs 'don pa bsgyur bas dngos grub blang ngo*// de yang slob ma la dbang bskur ba tsam gyi don du yin na/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ phur bu phyung*/ rdul tshon rnams

a kā ro 'i sngags kyi las kyi rjes mi mngon par byed/ rang don sgrub mchod la sogs pa dang 'brel na/ sang nyin dkyil 'khor sgrub kha'i dus sta gon bzhin du nam mkhar bteg de nas sngar bzhin du bsre ba/ mthar bsdu ba'i tshe dam tshig ye shes gnyis med bdag la bsre/ rdzas bsgrub rgyu yin na de la'o// de nas dge ba bsngo/ shis pa brjod/ rdul tshon chu bor dor tshe nā rākṣa gtso 'khor bskyed mchod bstod/ mthar rgya mtsho chen por yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i rgyur spyan drongs shig ces brjod/ de yang sgom pa brtan pa bogs dbyung ba'i phyir tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub na/ der phyag rgya 'cham la sogs pas rtse zhing 'dod pa lnga la rnam par rol/ ral gri'i dngos grub la sogs pa grub pa brgyad dam/ rtag pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyis zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rab 'byams gang gis sems can gang 'dul ba de dang de tha mal gyi yongs su dor bas spyad pa dpa' bo'i rim pa'o// gal te mchog bsgrub par 'dod na bskyed pa'i rim pa la goms nas sbyor ba'i 'phreng ba las bshad pa bzhin bsgom zhing*/ de la bogs 'byin pa'i phyir kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la sogs pa la yang 'jug par bya'o// de ltar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sgrub pa'i thabs kyi yi ge 'di ni/ gtsang rgyal mkhar rtse nas chos kyi rgyal po chen po rnam par rgyal bas ring mo zhig nas rtsom dgos zhes bskul bar mdzad pa dang*/ bla ma dang mgon po gnyis su med pa'i snang bas phyogs 'di la mi shes pa'i gnyid cung zad bsrabs pa padma dkar pos/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud/ sdom 'byung*/ khrag mtsho khol ma sogs bshad rgyud dang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i rgya gzhung rnams la brtags nas/ thub pa'i dgongs pa bzhin du rje btsun ras chung zhabs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i byang chub kyi snying po'i spo/

mog pa tshe kong zhes grags pa'i ri khrod/ lha rtse'i theg chen chos kyi pho brang du sbyar ba'i dge ba 'dis bdud dang bdud kyi mun pa bcom nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyin mo nyin mo las kyang nyin mor gyur cig /shog bu'i ngogs yangs lag pa'i 'gyur mang pos// rgyud sde'i gsang tshig ci yang 'don pa la// ngal ba med 'di tshangs pa'i bu su zhes// brtag par ci dgos gnyis pa mi snang ngo*// phyogs re'i mig ni 'di don dgag gzhi'i phyir// rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gzhal byar 'grim 'os pa// de la chags ldan sgeg mos dri mtshungs par// sems phebs bral na skyo ba tshad med lo// legs bshad rnam mang pusta ka ci yang*// 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin yin shes nas// gang gi bka' drin thob pa'i bzang lan du// pad dkar blo gros yangs pas sbyar ba yin// mkhas pas dbul zhing sgrub pas 'phongs pa'i sar// lan cig las kyis bskrad mod da ni nga*// dge mthu'i bzlog pa bklags la mi 'khrugs shing*// mkhas pa'i mdun sar mkhas pa ngoms par 'dod/// /sarba madga laṃ/// /
